# Headless DockWorkspace commits hang refreshPromise in promiseUpdate

## Context

When `Workstation` cold-boots with a saved vessel workspace (`apps/workstation/view/VesselWorkspace.mjs:253` → `createPopupWorkspace(..., {committed: true, windowId: null})`) or detaches a closed popup window while retaining its Group participant (`src/dashboard/dock/Workspace.mjs:1091-1094` / `apps/workstation/view/PopupWorkspace.mjs:260-261` → `this.parent?.remove(this, false, true); this.windowId = null`), the `Workspace` is unmounted (`mounted: false`), parentless (`parent: null`), and windowless (`windowId: null`).

Any Group commit or `projectDockZoneDocument` call against that headless `Workspace` (`cold-hydrate`, `Reset to default`, `Undo`, `transferItem`) hangs `refreshPromise` and `projectionCycle.adoption` indefinitely inside `await host.promiseUpdate()`.

Curated labels (`good first issue`, `help wanted`) are omitted because this is an active maintainer lane on `Neo.dashboard.dock.Workspace` claimed immediately.

## The Problem

In `src/dashboard/dock/Workspace.mjs:2688-2696`:
1. `Neo.currentWorker?.isWindowDeparted?.(host.windowId)` returns `false` when `host.windowId` is `null` (`src/worker/Base.mjs:433`).
2. `refreshDockWorkspace` falls into `if (!host.mounted) await host.promiseUpdate()`.
3. Under active VDOM updates (`!Neo.config.unitTestMode || Neo.config.allowVdomUpdatesInTests`), `VdomLifecycle#updateVdom` (`src/mixin/VdomLifecycle.mjs:1480-1509`) registers `{resolve, reject}` in `VDomUpdate.promiseCallbackMap[host.id]` and either parks on `needsVdomUpdate = true` (`!vnodeInitialized`) or waits on `mountedPromise`.
4. While the workspace remains headless (e.g. a saved vessel window that is never reopened, or across `cold-hydrate` followed by `Reset to default`), `refreshPromise` never settles, `projectionCycle.adoption` never resolves to `null`, subsequent cycles stall at `queuedAt` without `startedAt`, and `VDomUpdate.promiseCallbackMap` retains an orphaned callback entry. If multiple non-Group projections queue before a later mount, the first stale projection also wakes and reconciles before its successor instead of coalescing.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/dashboard/dock/Workspace.mjs:2052-2080`: `afterSetMounted(true)` already owns deferred replay of `me.departedProjection` via `me.chainProjection(parked)`.
- `src/dashboard/dock/Workspace.mjs:2688-2691`: `#20017` (`4763bcb8f9`) parks `{document, refreshOptions, tabInsertDescriptor}` in `me.departedProjection` when `isWindowDeparted(host.windowId)` is true, letting `Cycle#run`'s `.finally(() => me.adopt(null))` (`src/dashboard/dock/projection/Cycle.mjs:99`) settle `adoption` with `null`.
- `src/mixin/VdomLifecycle.mjs:1462`: unit tests with `allowVdomUpdatesInTests: false` (`test/playwright/unit/dashboard/DockWorkspace.spec.mjs:195-240`) exercise in-memory component reconciliation on standalone unmounted workspaces (`windowId: null`, `parent: null`) where `promiseUpdate()` resolves synchronously as a no-op. Note that an unadopted component defaults `parentId` to `'document.body'` (`parent: null`), whereas a mounting workspace inside a window's `Viewport` carries a live `parent` container and/or `windowId`.

Design authority: "A headless Workspace owns no visible tree before binding. Once mounted, an absent shell at `{@link #dockShellIndex}` enters the ordinary committed-document refresh" (`src/dashboard/dock/Workspace.mjs:2055-2057`) and "a cycle that is skipped, superseded, destroyed or repaired settles it with `null`, and the refresh stays the gate" (`src/dashboard/dock/projection/Cycle.mjs:13-14`).

Decision Record impact: none.

## The Fix

In `Neo.dashboard.dock.Workspace#refreshDockWorkspace` (`src/dashboard/dock/Workspace.mjs:2688`):
- Treat an unmounted, parentless, windowless host under active VDOM updates (`!host.mounted && !host.windowId && !host.parent && (!Neo.config.unitTestMode || Neo.config.allowVdomUpdatesInTests)`) identically to `Neo.currentWorker?.isWindowDeparted?.(host.windowId)`: store `{document, refreshOptions, tabInsertDescriptor}` in `me.departedProjection` and return immediately.
- When the headless workspace later binds and mounts into a container/window, `afterSetMounted(true)` replays the newest parked `departedProjection` once through `chainProjection`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Calling `projectDockZoneDocument` on an unmounted headless `Neo.dashboard.dock.Workspace` (`windowId: null`, `parent: null`, `allowVdomUpdatesInTests: true`) settles `refreshPromise` and resolves `projectionCycle.adoption` to `null` without registering callbacks in `VDomUpdate` or projecting premature shells while headless.
- [ ] Multiple headless `projectDockZoneDocument` commits coalesce into `departedProjection`, and subsequent container binding + mount (`bindAndMount`) projects the latest committed document once.
- [ ] Detaching a mounted `DockWorkspace` (`parent.remove(workspace, false, true); workspace.windowId = null`), committing a new document while detached, and remounting into a successor container projects the updated document cleanly.
- [ ] Existing unit suites (`DockWorkspaceFirstProjection.spec.mjs` and `DockWorkspace.spec.mjs`, including standalone `allowVdomUpdatesInTests: false` reconciliation) pass.

## Out of Scope

- Changing `VdomLifecycle#updateVdom` semantics for components actively mounting inside a parent container.
- The Ubuntu-only `WorkstationBoot.spec.mjs:273` `workstation-main` Reset render-stall race (`#21209`), where `workstation-main` is already mounted with a live `windowId`.

## Avoided Traps

- Checking `!host.windowId` unconditionally without `(!Neo.config.unitTestMode || Neo.config.allowVdomUpdatesInTests)` and `!host.mounted && !host.parent` would skip in-memory reconciliation in standalone unit specs (`DockWorkspace.spec.mjs:195`) or skip initial mount ordering when a workspace is already attached to a mounting parent container.
- Checking `!host.parentId` instead of `!host.parent` misses freshly constructed headless workspaces whose default `parentId` is `'document.body'` (`host.parent === null`).
